validation_points: Checks that sfAmount is XRP and > 0

code_paths.purpose: Performs all stateful validation and applies the PaymentChannelFund transaction to the ledger if valid.
validation_points: Checks reserve and funds (sfBalance, sfOwnerCount, sfAmount)

flow: PaymentChannelFund::doApply (used for funding, balance checks, and updating channel)
transformations: Validated as XRP and > 0 in preflight
Used to locate the payment channel in the ledger

decremented by ctx_.tx[sfAmount] if funding succeeds

description: Implements the logic for the PaymentChannelFund transaction in the XRPL, handling the addition of funds to an existing payment channel, including validation, permission checks, expiration extension, and ledger updates.

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfAmount
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: isXRP() and (ctx.tx[sfAmount] <= beast::zero) validates sfAmount for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfChannel
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: ctx_.view().peek(k) validates sfChannel for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfAccount
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: src != txAccount validates sfAccount for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfExpiration
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: (*slep)[~sfExpiration] and (*extend < minExpiration) validates sfExpiration for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfAccount (source account)
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: ctx_.view().peek(keylet::account(txAccount)) validates sfAccount (source account) for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfBalance and sfOwnerCount
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: balance < reserve validates sfBalance and sfOwnerCount for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfBalance and sfAmount
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: balance < reserve + ctx_.tx[sfAmount] validates sfBalance and sfAmount for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfDestination
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: ctx_.view().read(keylet::account(dst)) validates sfDestination for empty strings

false_positive_patterns.issue_pattern: Missing empty string validation for sfCancelAfter and sfExpiration
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: (cancelAfter && closeTime >= *cancelAfter) || (expiration && closeTime >= *expiration) validates sfCancelAfter and sfExpiration for empty strings

test_coverage_notes: PaymentChannelFund is typically tested in integration and unit tests for payment channels. Likely test files include PaymentChannel_test.cpp, PaymentChannelFund_test.cpp, or broader transaction engine tests. The preflight and doApply validations (amount, channel existence, permissions, expiration, reserve, destination) are usually covered. Gaps may exist for rare edge cases (e.g., internal errors, simultaneous expiration/cancel, malformed SLEs). LCOV_EXCL_LINE indicates some error paths may not be directly tested.

validation_architecture.framework: Custom validation in business logic (no external framework)

validates: Checks that sfAmount is an XRP amount (not IOU)
Checks that sfAmount is greater than zero
Checks that the payment channel exists
Checks that the transaction is submitted by the channel owner
Checks that the new expiration is not before the minimum allowed expiration
Checks that the source account exists
Checks that the account has enough balance to meet reserve requirements
Checks that the account has enough balance to fund the channel after reserve
Checks that the destination account exists
Checks if the channel should be closed due to expiration or cancelAfter
